name: Night Kitty Karaoke Bar
description: Night Kitty is a vibrant karaoke venue offering a dynamic experience with extensive song selections and high-quality sound systems. It features private rooms perfect for groups, along with an open stage for those who prefer a more communal vibe. The atmosphere is lively yet welcoming, with friendly staff ensuring a fun, safe environment. Guests can enjoy delicious drinks, affordable prices, and amenities like free popcorn, making it ideal for celebrations or casual nights out.
